data.content_ref: inline:Use a semiring of evidence, e.g., tropical or fuzzy, to assign each attack a weight and each defense a contribution; acceptance is determined by solving a polynomial-time system of equations over the semiring, with the grounded extension as the least solution. This generalizes integer weights but changes the algebraic structure. Criticizable because the choice of semiring is not uniquely justified and may make reinstatement non-structural or require an additional fixpoint that breaks polynomial cost.
